videos.author: TEDx Talks
videos.description:
Some people hear music. Corey Crossfield sees it, thanks to synesthesia, a commingling of the senses that turns sound into color. This talk explores how music teaches us to feel, and why the traits we try to hide can end up shaping our lives.

videos.title: The Importance of Outdoor Education | Colette Rossow | TEDxEncinitas Blvd
videos.author: TEDx Talks
videos.description:
This talk from Colette Rossow at TEDxEncinitasBlvd explores how outdoor education can improve mental health and appreciation for the natural world. With a thought-provoking presentation, this talk asks if you can name more leaves than corporate logos.
